app.title: MolvAI
app.subtitle: Voice typing
nav.label: Sections
daemon.title: Daemon
daemon.hint: The daemon owns the microphone and the model: recording is impossible without it.
daemon.crashed: The daemon exited with an error
daemon.crashedHint: Fix the cause and start the daemon again
daemon.downloadHint: The daemon starts by itself when the weights are downloaded and their checksum is verified
daemon.startingHint: The daemon is starting: it loads the model and may be downloading its weights, and the download progress is on the dashboard
daemon.startFailedHint: Run `molva daemon --foreground` to read the full error
dashboard.fileJobHint: The recognizer serves one job at a time: a phrase recorded now is queued and processed right after the file
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.levelZero: Zero input level: the microphone is silent
dashboard.levelZeroHint: Check the selected device and the system input volume
dashboard.signalLabel: Input level {level} percent, drawn as a pixel signal
dashboard.signalHint: One column per level the daemon sends. The picture records nothing
history.title: History
stats.title: Stats
search.title: Transcript search
search.hint: The search covers the transcriptions of audio and video files; a match shows the timecode of its segment.
search.empty: No transcriptions yet: the Files tab adds them.
app.managedHint: The settings file comes from the flake and is read-only. Change programs.molvai in the Nix configuration and run switch.
stats.chart: Words per day and average pace
stats.chartEmpty: No data for the chart yet
stats.confirmReset: Resetting stats erases the whole dictation journal. Continue?
snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.enabledHint: When the whole phrase matches an entry, its replacement goes to the field at once. The model is not called, and the replacement is not rewritten.
snippets.empty: No snippets yet: add a phrase and the text that should replace it.
snippets.noMatches: Nothing matches the search among {count} snippets.
snippets.phrasePlaceholder: For example, answer the client; * matches any text
snippets.managed: This page is read-only because Nix manages the settings. Change programs.molvai in the Nix configuration and run switch.
snippets.howBody: The phrase is compared with the text after the dictionary and the rules, and the whole phrase must match. Case, punctuation and repeated spaces do not matter. A * in the phrase matches any text, including nothing; an exact phrase wins over a wildcard one. A phrase that only contains the trigger does not match.
snippets.howHint: The replacement is final: no style and no model touch it. You can type a phrase or dictate it with the usual dictation hotkey.
files.title: Files
files.chooseFile: Choose an audio or video file
files.drop: Drop an audio or video file here or type a path
files.stopWaitingHint: The daemon owns the recognizer and a running file cannot be interrupted: the window stops waiting, while the daemon finishes the file and writes it to the history
files.hint: Transcription runs through the MolvAI daemon: the same recognizer serves dictation, this tab and the MCP server, and the result goes to the history.
files.timecodesHint: The copied text carries a timecode for each segment; switch them off to hide them in the list too.
files.interruptedHint: The window closed before the transcription finished. The result is not saved and the job did not complete.
files.progressUnknown: The daemon reports no share of the work for one file. The elapsed time is real; the bar only shows that the recognizer works.
files.waitingResult: The result appears when the daemon finishes.
files.emptyResult: The daemon finished without a result.
files.noSegments: The engine returned no segments, so this text has no timecodes.
files.previewDisabled: Media preview is temporarily off. The timecoded transcript and search work; the file opens in the system player.
files.mediaError: The window cannot open this file: {reason}
files.mediaUnsupported: This window cannot play the format: {reason}. The file opens in the system player.
files.spectrogramError: The window cannot decode this audio: {reason}. The player and the transcript still work.
files.spectrogramTooLong: This file is longer than {minutes} minutes. The window skips the spectrogram to keep its memory small; the player and the transcript still work.
files.spectrogramLabel: Audio spectrogram from {min} to {max} hertz. Click it to seek.
files.suggestions: Paths that match the typed text
files.suggestionHint: Tab or Enter fills the highlighted entry and does not start. Enter without a highlighted entry starts the transcription.
settings.title: Settings
settings.wayland.title: Hyprland
settings.wayland.body: MolvAI writes the binds to a file of their own and rewrites it when the hotkeys change.
settings.modelsMirrorHint: Empty means Hugging Face. The address of a directory with the ggml-*.bin files; each download is still checked against its SHA-256
settings.llm.cloudWarning: A cloud provider is selected: dictated text will leave this machine.
settings.llm.cloudConfirm: I understand the text goes to the cloud
settings.privacy.includeText: Keep dictated text in the journal
settings.privacy.sendToLlm: Allow sending text to the model
settings.privacy.telemetry: There is no telemetry and never will be
settings.importPath: Path to the settings file to import
settings.confirmReset: Reset every setting to its default?
error.title: Error
daemon.notRunningHint: Start the daemon with the "Start daemon" button or with `molva daemon`
validation.outOfRange: The value {value} is out of range
validation.zeroDuration: The recording length cannot be zero
validation.noModel: No speech recognition model is selected
validation.noBaseUrl: An enabled model needs an address
validation.noLlmModel: The model of the provider is not set
files.cliMissingHint: Build the CLI (`cargo build -p molva`) and put `molva` next to the GUI or on PATH
settings.autostartHint: Check write access to the user autostart directory
settings.modelOnDisk: The weights are on disk: the model starts at once.
settings.modelWillDownload: The weights are not on disk yet: the daemon downloads them at the start.
settings.modelMismatch: This model does not belong to the chosen engine. Pick a model of the engine.
settings.modelPathHint: Empty means the models directory of the data folder. A chosen model that is missing downloads at the daemon start.
settings.modelsError: The model catalog did not load, so the list of models is empty.
settings.remote.off: Cloud recognition is switched off in the daemon
settings.remote.offHint: The daemon refuses stt.engine = "remote-openai" in this build. The address, the model and the key below are saved to the settings file but bring no recognition until the core builds a remote client.
settings.sttLanguageHint: Add the languages to recognize. One language is faster; two or more turn on automatic detection.
settings.allowedLanguagesHint: Automatic detection chooses among these languages.
settings.autoPull: Download the weights at the daemon start
settings.autoPullHint: Without it a missing model is an error that names the molva models pull command.
settings.deviceLoading: Waiting for the daemon: the device list is not available yet.
settings.deviceNone: The daemon reports no input device.
settings.deviceError: The device list did not load.
settings.deviceErrorHint: Start the daemon and press Refresh. The daemon opens its socket only after the weights are ready.
settings.llm.localHint: A local model needs no key and does not send the text away.
settings.llm.keyPresent: The key is in the store as {entry}
settings.llm.keyMissing: No key in the store for this provider.
settings.llm.keyStoreRefused: The key store did not answer. Check the system keyring or choose the env source.
settings.llm.keyStoreHint: Check the key store of the system, or use the environmental variable source
settings.llm.dataCollectionDeny: Deny: do not let providers keep or train on the text
settings.llm.dataCollectionAllow: Allow: providers may keep the text by their own terms
settings.llm.dataCollectionHint: This goes to OpenRouter with every request. Other providers ignore it.
settings.keySource.plain: Plain text in the settings file
settings.keySource.legacy: Other source of the settings file
settings.keySource.plainWarning: The plain source writes the key into the settings file in clear text. Any program that reads your files reads the key too.
settings.keySourceHint.store: The key goes to the key store of the system and never into the settings file.
settings.keySourceHint.plain: The key is stored openly in the settings file. Use it only where no key store exists.
settings.keySourceHint.env: The key is read from the named variable of the daemon environment.
settings.keySourceHint.none: No key is sent. A cloud provider refuses such a request.
settings.keySourceHint.legacy: The settings file names a source that this page does not offer. Choosing another source replaces it.
settings.styles.builtinHint: These are the defaults. They cannot be edited or deleted. A custom style with the same id replaces one of them.
settings.styles.customHint: A style is an instruction for the model. The default style is above; every entry here appears in the style menu.
settings.styles.name: Display name
settings.styles.blocked: A custom style is incomplete: fill the fields that are marked, or the settings cannot be saved.
settings.styles.issue.emptyId: A custom style needs an identifier
settings.styles.issue.duplicateId: Another custom style already uses this identifier
settings.styles.issue.emptyName: A custom style needs a display name
settings.styles.issue.emptyPrompt: A style that calls the model needs a system prompt
settings.hotkeys.hint: Click a field and press the combination. Escape cancels, and a modifier alone is not a shortcut.
settings.hotkeys.modifierOnly: A modifier alone is not a shortcut. Add a key.
settings.hotkeys.unsupported: The daemon cannot bind this key. Choose a letter, a digit, F1 to F12 or a named key.
settings.mcp.enabled: Allow harnesses to start the MCP server
settings.mcp.enabledHint: The switch turns the stdio server off without touching the harness configuration.
settings.mcp.stdioHint: This is a stdio process: the harness starts it, and it keeps running only while the harness holds it. There is no port, no URL and no autostart.
error.cloudConsent: Confirm cloud sending in Privacy before recording.
settings.privacy.cloudConsent: Allow text and audio to reach cloud services
settings.llm.zdrHint: OpenRouter keeps neither the request nor the answer after processing.
settings.llm.hostersHint: The order in which OpenRouter tries its hosters, and what it may do when one of them cannot answer. Other providers ignore these fields.
settings.llm.hostersOrderHint: Comma-separated OpenRouter hoster names, for example groq, together. Empty means the router picks the hoster.
settings.llm.allowFallbacksHint: When the chosen hosters fail, OpenRouter may ask another one.
settings.llm.requireParameters: Only hosters that honour every parameter
settings.llm.requireParametersHint: OpenRouter drops hosters that ignore a parameter of the request.
settings.llm.testHint: Sends one short prompt through the draft settings. Nothing is saved and no dictated text leaves the machine.
settings.llm.modelHint: Set the model name of the provider in the field above
settings.llm.probeConsentHint: Allow cloud sending in Privacy, then run the test again
settings.llm.probeAuthHint: Check the API key of this provider in the store or in the environment variable
settings.llm.probeTimeoutHint: The provider did not answer within {seconds} s. Check the address and the network, or raise llm.timeout_secs
settings.llm.probeUnavailableHint: Check the address and that the model server is running
settings.sttTest.hint: Checks the engine, the weights and transcribe-cli only. Nothing is recorded and the microphone stays untouched.
settings.sttTest.failed: The draft settings cannot recognize yet
settings.sttTest.cliMissing: transcribe-cli not found: install transcribe.cpp or set its path
settings.sttTest.remoteUnavailable: This build does not implement remote recognition: use whisper-cpp or transcribe-cpp with local weights
settings.llm.reasoningHint: Default: the model does not think and answers at once. OpenRouter ignores this and uses the default of the model. low, medium and high ask for longer thinking.
dashboard.styleNeedsLlm: This style needs a language model: enable it in Settings
settings.transcribeCliHint: Leave empty when transcribe-cli is in PATH; this is the transcribe.cpp executable.
settings.llm.testCloudNote: The answer came from a cloud provider.
